observations: A black manual sewing machine with gold decorative accents is shown on a wooden table.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right side and a foot pedal attached to the front.
The base is wooden with metal rivets and a metal plate with a watermark 'MAY LENAPHEAL'.
The machine appears to be vintage, with visible wear and some chipped paint on the base.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in the photo.
The background has a patterned curtain.

claims.evidence: The machine's condition shows wear and paint chipping, but durability and reliability cannot be assessed from a single photo. No test or usage history is shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the needle moving and the handwheel turning smoothly.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical issues such as worn gears, broken belt, or damaged needle bar.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, belt, and internal gears, or a video showing the machine sewing a test stitch.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential parts such as the presser foot, bobbin case, or manual.
risks.proof: A photo showing all components laid out, including the presser foot, bobbin case, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of the model plate, usually on the side of the head or near the motor.
Video of the machine in operation, including the needle moving and handwheel turning.
Close-up photos of the needle area, belt, and internal gears.
Photo showing all components laid out, including presser foot and bobbin case.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
